newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Savings Bank postpones share issue.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Savings Bank postpones share issue.

text.p: Estonia's second largest commercial bank, Savings Bank, on Wednesday postponed two issues of new shares which were aimed at raising 32 million kroons because of technical reasons, a spokeswoman for the bank said.
A new shareholders meeting has been called for September 30 to vote on the offer of 3.2 million shares at 10 kroons each.
Savings Bank made first-half profits of 22.3 million kroons. Estonia's largest bank, Hansapank, is one of its main shareholders along with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
Savings Bank earlier this year bought the former state-owned Estonian insurance company and is to merge with the country's eighth largest bank, the Bank of Industry.
